<<<POU name=ProductionLine kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK ProductionLine
VAR_INPUT
    Mode : BOOL;
    ForwardButton : BOOL;
    ReverseButton : BOOL;
    SensorA : BOOL;
    SensorB : BOOL;
    SensorC : BOOL;
    ButtonA : BOOL;
    ButtonB : BOOL;
    ButtonC : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorForward : BOOL;
    MotorReverse : BOOL;
    CompletionLight : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    stage : INT := 0;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
MotorForward := FALSE;
MotorReverse := FALSE;
CompletionLight := FALSE;
IF NOT Mode THEN
    IF ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton THEN
        MotorReverse := TRUE;
    ELSIF ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton THEN
        MotorForward := TRUE;
    END_IF
    stage := 0;
ELSE
    CASE stage OF
    0:
        IF SensorA AND ButtonA THEN
            stage := 1;
        END_IF
    1:
        MotorForward := TRUE;
        IF SensorB THEN
            stage := 2;
        END_IF
    2:
        IF ButtonB THEN
            stage := 3;
        END_IF
    3:
        MotorForward := TRUE;
        IF SensorC THEN
            stage := 4;
        END_IF
    4:
        IF ButtonC THEN
            stage := 5;
        END_IF
    5:
        CompletionLight := TRUE;
        IF NOT SensorC THEN
            stage := 0;
        END_IF
    END_CASE
END_IF
<<<END>>>
